title: MetricSeries
description: A time series of metric data points for a specific metric type on an SAP HANA Cloud service instance.

metricType.description: The type of metric (e.g., cpu_usage, memory_used, disk_used, active_connections).

unit.description: The unit of measurement (e.g., percent, bytes, count).

dataPoints.description: The time-ordered list of metric data points.
